2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device separate from a set-top terminal__.

3. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber __by communicating directly with the content delivery provider__; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber.

4. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider __via a network connection__; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier does not belong to the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers __wherein the removing is performed by a processor separate from a conditional access processor__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the programs are delivered by one of a television network, a cable operator, a direct satellite program provider, a digital cable content provider, and a network content provider __and wherein the filtering is performed at a location remote from the content delivery provider__.

7. 8. (Currently amended) The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: displaying the filtered EPG information __on a display device separate from a set-top terminal__.

10.
